articles.title: Portable Pole Jack vs Crane: Narrow Alley Erection Field Guide
articles.description: Field evaluation of 300kg portable hydraulic pole lifters compared to 16-ton boom truck rentals in tight municipal alleys.

sections.heading: Jobsite Logistics in Tight Municipal Alleys
paragraphs: Contractors aiming for crane rental cost savings face severe logistical roadblocks when deploying 16-ton mobile boom trucks into tight pedestrian alleys.
Under OSHA 1926 Subpart CC, minimum approach distances to overhead electrical conductors introduce extensive setup delays.

sections.heading: Two-Person Hydraulic Workflow: 300kg Tested Load
paragraphs: The portable system features a verified 300kg vertical load rating calibrated on dedicated factory test rigs, accommodating street light poles up to 12m in height.
Tired of high rental bills? Calculate your project savings with the Crane ROI Calculator.

sections.heading: Universal Base Plate & Flange Bolt Compatibility
paragraphs: The universal base plate accommodates 180-260mm P.C.D. bolt circle patterns using M16 to M24 studs conforming to ASTM F1554 standards.
Contractors can submit their project drawings for a free base flange engineering drawing review before fabrication.
